title: Models used
purpose: One list of every model and agent program ta-amps uses, and what for. Pages, the film and Herma take names from here, so a name never drifts from what runs.
display_rules: Meta models come first and carry the emphasis.
An asterisk (*) marks a model from another maker, used only where Meta offers no model for the job, or as a fallback that is recorded every time it is used.
Show only uses whose state is 'live' or 'measured'. Never show a stamp such as planned or coming soon.
A harness (agent program) is never called a model; always name the model it ran.

states.live: running in the live system now
states.measured: a recorded run or evaluation with saved results
states.pending: being switched over or trained; keep off pages until it becomes live or measured
